text: CECONOMY AG runs brands such as MediaMarkt, MediaWorld and Saturn. JD.com secured about 59.8% of CECONOMY's shares in its takeover offer (announced 2 December 2025); on 30 June 2026 JD.com said it expected the offer to close in the second half of 2026, subject to further regulatory closing conditions.
short: MediaMarkt is a brand of CECONOMY AG, which JD.com has agreed to take over.

source.name: EQS News: JD.com successfully secures 59.8% of CECONOMY as final result after end of additional acceptance period
source.quote: The company is a leader for concepts and brands such as MediaMarkt, MediaWorld and Saturn in the consumer electronics sector in Europe.

additionalSources.quote: Subject to the fulfilment of further customary regulatory closing conditions, we expect the offer to be closed in the second half of 2026
